# Roberta Colapietro

<br>

<img src="img/main.png" style="width: 40%; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; border-radius: 50%; float: left; margin-right: 40px;"/>

I am a PhD student at the [Charité Medical University](https://www.charite.de/en/) where I explore how cells keep track of time in health and disease. <br><br>
I also love make this (and other) research topics accessible to the public through a variety of science outreach formats. <br><br>
